name: az-company-formation
description: Company formation and entity choice in Azerbaijan for tax year 2026. Covers the limited liability company (MMC) under the Civil Code (no statutory minimum capital, capital paid before registration or within at most 3 months), joint-stock companies (minimum AZN 2,000 closed, AZN 4,000 open), branches and representative offices of foreign companies, and the individual entrepreneur; registration with the State Tax Service, the statutory registration times (immediate or 1 day for an electronic local-investment LLC, 2 days for other commercial entities), the state duty (none for an electronic LLC, AZN 15 on paper, AZN 300 for branches and financial firms); and the first-year tax calendar. Trigger phrases: set up a company in Azerbaijan, register MMC, LLC Azerbaijan, Azerbaijan registration fee, fərdi sahibkar, foreign branch Azerbaijan. Out of scope: tax computations (az-corporate-income-tax, azerbaijan-income-tax, azerbaijan-vat, azerbaijan-payroll, azerbaijan-social-contributions) and tax
